eligible for automated placement of
Prod, CVAL/NonProd & DR
(PS scoring via HC-8 / HC-9)

Prod-only exception path
(Scenario 2, operator approval;
CVAL/DR never allowed — VR-6)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2-region co-located distribution (EU · Australia · Asia Pacific):
Prod in one region;
CVAL + DR co-located in the other
(mandatory & deterministic — PLC-010a)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cross-geo DR (Middle East) [Amended v2.4]:
Prod + CVAL co-located in a weighted-selected ME region;
DR placed cross-geo in a weighted-selected Europe region
(weighted model; DR-020, PLC-010b; Europe sizes DR max-not-sum, DR-017)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Regions are canonical examples from the Requirements Baseline v2.4 Section 6,
Hard Constraints Reference and Calculation Logic Reference. Actual Azure region
inventory may differ; the authoritative Standard/Restricted lists and each
geography's distribution model live in PlacementPolicy (HC-8 / HC-9 / REG-001).
